== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Everwood refers to a continent located on the opposite side of the world, which is difficult to reach through space without specialized means. It is ruled by [[Emriss Silentborn]], the [[Monarch]] of [[Titan]]'s Grove and [[Queen]] of the [[Everwood continent|Everwood Continent]]. Unlike many other [[Monarchs]] who project intense [[Spiritual pressure|spiritual pressure]], [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]] is known for a soothing and reassuring presence. The [[inhabitants]] of the continent are primarily humans with various dark skin tones who practice unique [[sacred arts]], often accompanied by spirits or [[Remnants]]. The continent is also home to [[Dreadnought City]]. The region is notable for its connection to men’hla trees. It is rumored that [[Emriss Silentborn]] was a [[men'hla tree]] prior to her ascension, and these trees are considered sacred on the continent. These trees are highly prized by [[Soulsmiths]] because their leaves can produce individual [[Remnants]], providing a consistent source of material for various projects. Additionally, the continent is associated with unique flora and fauna, such as the [[Moongrave amphelia]], which was originally sourced from Everwood.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Located on the opposite side of the world, Everwood is a significant destination where [[Lindon]] was expected to arrive. The region serves as the seat of the [[Monarch of Everwood]] and is home to the [[Silent King]], who resides in its center. Within this location, various assignments can be found. Furthermore, the area is notable because most individuals outside of Everwood lack the ability to draw from the [[Dreamway]] freely.}}
